slice: PAR-134 LAYER CMC raw flags/index and book-only retention
source_reference: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §2.11 CmColor

fields: separate CMC color-name and color-book strings

implementation.model: DRW_Layer appends CMC flags/index/provenance and separate name/book fields; the public BOOK$ENTRY view preserves book-only values as BOOK$.
implementation.parser: The bounded LAYER CMC read retains flags, leading BS, and each optional string; reset and DXF color parsing clear the DWG-only provenance.
implementation.dwg_writer: Valid parsed C0-C3 metadata replays source name/book flags. Unknown flag bits, nonzero R2004+ leading BS, incompatible source methods, and inconsistent raw string/flag state refuse before CMC output.
implementation.cmc_writer: putCmColorWithFlags emits source flags including flagged empty TV strings and rejects unknown flags or strings whose flags are absent.
implementation.adapter_accounting: Layer callback estimates charge both newly retained private strings.
implementation.dxf_writer: Existing group 430 BOOK$ENTRY behavior is unchanged; group 430 round-trips BOOK$ for a book-only CMC.
implementation.compatibility: DRW_Layer object size and dwgBufferW API change; downstream consumers must rebuild. No vtable changed.

generated_controls.full_dwg_roundtrip: AC1024 and AC1032 local writer/reader controls cover named C2 RGB, named C3 ACI, book-only C3, metadata accessors, copy/reset, rewrite, and reread.
generated_controls.cmc_wire: Generated CMC bytes retain a set name flag with an empty TV string and align the following sentinel.
generated_controls.fail_closed: Direct encoder controls inject unknown 0x80 flags and nonzero leading BS index; both refuse with body/string/handle buffers unchanged.
generated_controls.dxf_roundtrip: ASCII and Binary DXF group 430 controls preserve BOOK$ and clear DWG-only provenance on import.
